note: DECLARED EXECUTION ROOTS — the reviewable escape hatch of the dead-code fence. An entry belongs here ONLY when a REAL mechanism executes the file and the analyzer cannot see that mechanism. Each entry carries a one-line reason naming that mechanism. This is NOT a place to make the unreachable count look better: a file that is merely documented, merely exported, or merely deliberately unwired belongs in .ctoc/reachability-baseline.json as DEBT.

Git runs it after every commit — real execution, not a citation.
reasons.src/scripts/collapse-stacked-frontmatter: Executed BY A HUMAN.
